name: agent-cafe
description: Seats every agent of your Claude sessions, main loop and subagents alike, in a café and shows what each one is doing right now: in a pane (/cafe), or on your own web page, a 3D café where they walk around, with cats, dogs and lo-fi music.

share_sessions.title: Seat other sessions
share_sessions.description: Also seat the agents of your other Claude Code sessions on this machine (each session needs this mod loaded).

motion.title: Animation
motion.description: Animate the café picture. Turn it off if the picture flickers or does not show on your machine: it is then drawn as a plain still image.

web_url.title: Web page address
web_url.description: Optional. The address of your own café web page (see the README), e.g. https://cafe.example.com, or http://localhost:8080 when it runs on this machine. Leave it empty to keep the café in the pane only.

web_key.title: Web page reporting key
web_key.description: Optional. The page's reporting key (CAFE_INGEST_KEY in web/.env). It can only send reports, not look at the café.
